scripts.name: Hello, World Example

scripts.author: rabidgremlin

scripts.name: Copy to artboards
scripts.description: Duplicates selected object(s) onto every other artboard in the document
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Swap objects by center
scripts.description: Swap the locations of two selected objects by their center points.
scripts.author: daani-rika

scripts.name: Smart JPEG export
scripts.description: Exports all/selected artboards, spreads or docs with max. size limit
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Single-char linebreak fix
scripts.description: Replaces spaces after lone single characters with non-breaking spaces (Slavic languages)
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Generate Crop Marks
scripts.description: Generates crop/cut marks for selected objects and Data Merge Layout grids. For DML nodes always asks the user for rows/columns via dialog. Adds L-shaped corner marks and internal grid ticks to a locked Production Marks layer.
scripts.author: sakura

scripts.name: Custom Gradient Map
scripts.description: Creates a custom gradient map based on a selected gradient swatch.
scripts.author: RE4LLY

scripts.name: Zig Zag Effect
scripts.description: This script transforms a selected shape or line into a zig zag pattern. Simply select a shape or path, run the script, and it will automatically apply a zig zag effect to it.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Bento Box Generator
scripts.description: Generates Bento Grid/Box on the current page/artboard
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: ReColorFill
scripts.description: Allows users to quickly change the fill color/gradients of selected shapes.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Hanging chars and prepositions
scripts.description: Replaces spaces after lone single characters or prepositions with non-breaking spaces (for slavic languages). Based on initial script by JiriKrblich
scripts.author: nodeus

scripts.name: RGB Finder
scripts.description: Looks for all embedded and linked RGB images in an open Affinity document. Useful for CMYK documents.
scripts.author: hrum

scripts.name: Dithering
scripts.description: Adjustable halftone dithering effect with 12 dithering algorithms.
scripts.author: bitmancer

scripts.name: ReColorStroke
scripts.description: Allows users to quickly change the stroke color or gradients of selected shapes.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: PuckerBloatEffect
scripts.description: Applies a Pucker & Bloat effect to the selected object(s), pulling anchor points inward (Pucker) or outward (Bloat) to distort
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: DeleteEmptyGroups
scripts.description: Deletes empty groups left behind by the user.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Randomize Objects
scripts.description: Randomization of size, position, rotation, skew, opacity, color, and stroke of selected objects.
scripts.author: zaum

scripts.name: Directional Blur Shadow
scripts.description: Directional Blur Shadow creates a directional shadow of an object that progressively blurs, fades and tapers as it moves away from the object.
scripts.author: rbonelli

scripts.name: OKLCH Color
scripts.description: Edit, paste and save OKLCH colors.
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Split to grid
scripts.description: Split vector object into n*n grid
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Crack and Explode
scripts.description: Create radial cracks in the shape and explode it.
scripts.author: rbonelli

scripts.name: Distribute Shapes on Paths
scripts.description: Places copies of designated target layers along selected vector shapes or paths. Choose the target layer by name from the dropdown or rename it to target. Multiple matching layers are distributed in round-robin order. Supports vector, group, symbol, and pixel layers, with insertion modes for path, center, nodes, and corners.
scripts.author: EricP

scripts.name: ReplaceObjectwithObject
scripts.description: The script replaces all selected objects with duplicates of the key object (select 2 objects then press Option on Mac or Alt on Windows on the object you want to become the key object), while preserving position and rotation, with optional size matching.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: SeparateFill&Stroke
scripts.description: Separates combined fill and stroke appearances into independent objects for easier editing and output control.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Arrange on Path
scripts.description: Distributes selected objects evenly along auto-detected vector paths, with support for multiple paths, randomization, interpolation, smart sorting, open/closed paths, and repeat mode for tiling objects along the path.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Swap Objects
scripts.description: The script swaps selected objects based on a custom mapping, with optional orientation and dimension swapping. Select at least 2 objects, choose how they should swap in the dialog, then use Preview or Apply.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Toggle Layer Visibility Across All Pages
scripts.description: Layer States alternative. Select a layer, then run this script. It reads the layer's name and current visibility, then toggles all layers with the same name across every page/spread.
scripts.author: hrum

scripts.name: Move Layer to Top Across All Pages
scripts.description: Select a layer, then run this script. It finds all layers with the same name across every page/spread and moves them to the top of the layer stack.
scripts.author: hrum

scripts.name: Roughen Edges
scripts.description: Rough up vector paths with controls over amplitute, frequency, noise etc.
scripts.author: Nic Kraneis

scripts.name: Glitch effect
scripts.description: Create a glitch effect on a vector object.
scripts.author: Nic Kraneis

scripts.name: Pattern Maker
scripts.description: Create patterns from an object. Supports brick and drop patterns.
scripts.author: Nic Kraneis

scripts.name: Cropmarks
scripts.description: Places cutting marks 2 mm away from the Trimbox in the same color as the registration marks
scripts.author: Wolfgang Wiesen

scripts.name: Style Consistency Checker
scripts.description: Easily maintain design consistency by inspecting and remapping font faces, sizes, and stroke weights. Also includes a tool to clean up invisible garbage nodes
scripts.author: Shigeru Kobayashi

scripts.name: Fill Path With Objects
scripts.description: This script fills a selected closed vector path with multiple copies of one or more template objects. It supports different grid types (rectangular, hex, circular, radial, etc.), randomization, scaling, rotation, and spacing controls. Select a closed path and objects, adjust settings, then preview or apply.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Gridify
scripts.description: Spread selected objects into a grid with various options of spacing, scaling and jitter.
scripts.author: Nic Kraneis

scripts.name: Extrude Tool
scripts.description: This script generates a 3D-like extrusion effect by connecting selected vector shapes. Once executed, the tool automatically calculates, subdivides, and renders the connecting geometry, organizing the resulting faces while preserving your original shapes as caps
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Export Carroussel
scripts.description: Export a single document as individual panels of a specified size.
scripts.author: rbonelli

scripts.name: Create Carroussel
scripts.description: Creates a new single document ready for a Carroussel image, with X panels divided with Guidelines.
scripts.author: rbonelli

scripts.name: 3D fun
scripts.description: Creates faux 3D objects
scripts.author: S1m0nP1

scripts.name: Artboard Batch Renamer
scripts.description: Renames all artboards in the current document in bulk. When executed, a dialog prompts for a base name, which is then applied to all artboards with automatic sequential numbering and zero-padding — ensuring correct alphabetical sort order when exporting files (e.g., Name 01, Name 02... instead of Name 1, Name 2). For 100+ artboards, padding adjusts to 3 digits automatically. If only one artboard exists, no number is appended.
scripts.author: Heitor Hatherly

scripts.name: Twist Effect
scripts.description: This script applies a progressive polar rotation (twist) to selected curves, shapes, or groups, mimicking Adobe Illustrator's twist effect. Select your vector elements first; the script subdivides Bezier curves, twists points radially based on distance from the center, and reconstructs the path.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Tile Generator
scripts.description: This script generates tile-based patterns from a selected object. It supports multiple layout styles, including a basic grid, brick offset, half-drop, diamond, hexagonal, radial burst, spiral, wave, pinwheel, and random scatter. It also includes progressive hue shifting, which reads the source object’s solid fill color and shifts the hue across all tiles, for example by 180° to create complementary colors.
scripts.author: S1m0nP1

scripts.name: Vector Lathe (Revolve)
scripts.description: This script revolves a selected vector path into a lathe-style 3D form. Select one path first, then run it; the script creates the revolved geometry, applies shading, and organizes the result into containers for visible faces and caps.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Combine Text For Braille Output
scripts.description: When you intend to send a copy of your work to a blind person, it can take a lot of time to merge all the text boxes over many pages into one Word file. This Claude generated script starts at the beginning of the document and collects all the text from the text boxes and merges it into a txt file on your desktop. This can then be opened in Word for final processing before sending to Braille.
scripts.author: BaconThatsIt

scripts.name: Export DDS
scripts.description: Exports the current Affinity document as a DDS file using BC3/DXT5 compression with auto-generated mipmaps.
scripts.author: jeffthor10

scripts.name: Artboard Fitter
scripts.description: Resizes artboards based on content with custom padding and axis selection (Height, Width, or Both). Automatically groups elements, centers them, and maintains proportions without distortion regardless of DPI.
scripts.author: Heitor Hatherly

scripts.name: Professional Chart Generator - CSV Import
scripts.description: Generates pie charts and bar charts from an imported CSV file
scripts.author: Ouriel MAKAYA

scripts.name: Affinity Logo Grid
scripts.description: Creates editable orthogonal, angled, tangent, circular, node, and Bezier handle construction guides from selected logo/SVG vectors.
scripts.author: Yore-Des

scripts.name: Vector Block Shadow Tool
scripts.description: Replicate the Block Shadow functionality from CorelDRAW by generating a solid, 2D vector extrusion from a source object. Unlike a drop shadow, this must result in a flat vector path capable of being sent to a plotter or vinyl cutter.
scripts.author: jn-373

scripts.name: Vector Block Shadow Tool
scripts.description: Scatters selected objects with adjustable parameters. Select a single group to scatter its children.
scripts.author: Claude via Matt I.

scripts.name: SELECT+
scripts.description: Utility that select layers by relationship (eg. all layers within a group), containment (objects inside another shape), random distribution, or pattern-based rules.
scripts.author: EricP

scripts.name: Arabic RTL Pro
scripts.description: Converts selected Arabic text into visual RTL text for Affinity, with lam-alef shaping, right alignment, optional tatweel removal, harakat ordering, and precise global plus individual harakat size and X/Y offset controls.
scripts.author: Dimas Nirwan

scripts.name: Hebrew RTL Flip Helper
scripts.description: Fixes Hebrew RTL issues with selectable modes.
scripts.author: Tzvi20

scripts.name: Type Scale Builder PT Fix 1.2
scripts.description: Type Scale Builder is an Affinity 3 JavaScript script that generates a modular typography system from a user-defined base text size. It lets designers choose a scale ratio, rounding mode, line-height logic, font, preview text, and the number of steps above/below the body size. The script then creates a clean editorial type specimen inside the current document, showing each generated style with its size, line-height, and preview sentence.
scripts.author: Seba

scripts.name: Image Trace Superior
scripts.description: Converts raster/image layers into clean, scalable black-and-white vectors directly inside Affinity — no external tools needed. Engine: marching-squares contour tracer with adaptive Bezier smoothing, corner-aware RDP simplification, and anti-staircase curve fitting.
scripts.author: Dimas Nirwan

scripts.name: Duplicate at Selected Nodes
scripts.description: Duplicates the front/top selected object at every selected on-curve node on the other selected curve objects.
scripts.author: Dimas Nirwan

scripts.name: Simplify Curves
scripts.description: Script for reducing points of object curves
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Block_Text
scripts.description: Scales selected art text to match the widest, left-aligns all objects, and spaces them vertically with a all objects, and spates them verticaly with a configurable point gap.
scripts.author: pgraficzny

scripts.name: Curve Mockup Overlay
scripts.description: Draw presentation-style fake anchor points and Bezier handles over the selected curve.
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Smart Exporter
scripts.description: Export the selected artboard or selected objects to multiple formats in one run.
scripts.author: JiriKrblich

scripts.name: Shape Scatter
scripts.description: Instantly scatter perfect clones of any vector shape. Features auto-canvas detection, exact style preservation, dynamic size/rotation jitter, and overlap prevention across multiple patterns (Random, Grid, Burst). Real-time previews bake into a single, optimized node to keep your layers panel perfectly clean.
scripts.author: hellsfaun

scripts.name: Smart Quotes Converter
scripts.description: Replaces all straight quotes in your document with proper typographic smart quotes across every text frame on every spread.
scripts.author: MeowWereTalking

scripts.name: Select By Matching Color
scripts.description: Selects all objects in the parent layer whose fill OR stroke color matches that of the currently selected object. Comparison is done in RGBA8 (including alpha channel).
scripts.author: kevinblancharddesign-hub

scripts.name: Pizza Cutter
scripts.description: Slice a selected object into a precise pie or grid pieces
scripts.author: hellsfaun

scripts.name: Aesthetic Colorizer
scripts.description: This script lets you select objects, pick a base color, and instantly colorize the selection with coordinated tints and shades derived from that color.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Radial Repeat
scripts.description: Select one or more objects, then duplicate them automatically in a radial layout around the center of the selection. The script supports multiple circular rows, live preview, controls for radius, spacing, rotation, and scaling, plus a row template mode for assigning different selected objects to specific rows
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Make Button
scripts.description: Instantly creates perfectly padded rounded button backgrounds behind selected text layers with live preview, customizable fill/stroke styling, linked padding controls, and automatic grouping.
scripts.author: hellsfaun

scripts.name: Group Cleanup
scripts.description: Deletes empty groups and releases plain single-item groups.
scripts.author: hellsfaun

scripts.name: Empty Clipping Masks
scripts.description: Deletes all children from every selected object. Clear all shapes inside objects in one click.
scripts.author: jn-373

scripts.name: Apple Style Squircle Tool
scripts.description: Create Squircles from Squares in Apple App Icon Style with Live-Preview option.
scripts.author: Dan Schumacher

scripts.name: Advanced Markdown to Affinity Publisher
scripts.description: Import your Markdown file and instantly transform it into a fully styled Affinity Publisher layout.
scripts.author: Torsten Dinkheller

scripts.name: Duplicate Selection to Opposite Page
scripts.description: Select one or more objects on a page, then run the script to duplicate them automatically to the opposite paired page in the same relative position. The script detects the source page from the selected objects, chooses the matching target page automatically, and supports paired-page logic such as 2↔3, 4↔5, 6↔7, and so on.
scripts.author: BlackMortimer-13

scripts.name: Quick Mirror
scripts.description: Mirrors the selected layer to the left, right, top, or bottom with an adjustable gap.
scripts.author: hellsfaun
